rules.objective: Form a hand whose total value is as near as possible to 21 without going over; beat the banker. Best hand is Pontoon (Ace plus ten-value card in two cards), then Five Card Trick (five cards totaling 21 or less), then 21 in three or four cards; hands over 21 are bust. Banker wins ties.
rules.gameplay:
1. Setup: One player is banker (first banker chosen at random). Banker deals one card face down to each player; players other than banker look at their card and place initial bets within agreed min and max. Banker deals a second card face down to each. If banker has Pontoon, banker collects double from each and hand ends.
2. Players' turns: From dealer's left, each player may declare Pontoon (A-J/10), split equal ranks (extra bet, two hands), buy a card (add to stake, card face down), twist (no extra stake, card face up), or stick (total at least 15). Once a player has twisted, they cannot buy. Over 21 is bust; banker takes stake and cards. Five cards under 21 is a Five Card Trick; no more cards allowed.
3. Banker's turn: Banker exposes two cards, may take more face up, or stay. Banker bust pays all non-bust players (double for Pontoon/Five Card Trick). Otherwise banker pays hands that beat the banker (double for Pontoon/Five Card Trick), collects from equal or lower. Banker wins ties.
4. New deal: If no Pontoon was declared, used cards go under pack without shuffling. If a player (not banker) had Pontoon without splitting, that player becomes next banker (nearest to dealer's left if tied).
keyRules: Pontoon (A+10 in two cards) beats Five Card Trick beats 21 in 3-4 cards beats lower point totals; bust loses
Stick only on 15 or more; buy adds to stake; twist does not; no buy after twist
Banker wins all ties; banker pays double for Pontoon and Five Card Trick
